variant: V3 diameter-6 by 3 mm disc-magnet base
qualification: CAD/print-fit prototype; attachment force and phone compatibility require measurement

magnet.phone_facing_polarity: Unassigned until measured phone/case tests; record each pocket before bonding
magnet.polarity_note: One row of axial discs does not reproduce the V2 opposite inner/outer radial poles. CAD does not establish MagSafe holding force.
magnet.supplier_note: Patel lists N35 and N52: select N52. JC lists conflicting +/-0.05 and +/-0.1 mm tolerances; design uses +/-0.1 mm. Confirm batch dimensions/grade and delivery before ordering.

pockets.insertion: From the phone-facing underside directly into the one-piece base
pockets.retention: Qualified nonconductive sidewall adhesive; magnet sits against dry blind stop; no glue layer above magnet

unchanged_interfaces: RevC PCB and CR2450 holder/cell poses

encoder.installation: Insert the same axial6x3mm disc on edge from inside the cap; seat its curved edge against the dry stop and retain with sidewall adhesive
encoder.qualification: Physical field strength and TMAG3001 range/counting must be tested; a flat centered axial disc cannot provide the intended XY angle signal
